question: Have I concealed a mortal sin in confession?
In confession, have I failed to be sincerely sorry for my sins, or had no real intention of amending my life?
Have I received Holy Communion or another sacrament while in mortal sin?
Since my last confession, have I failed to make good, as far as I could, the harm I had caused?
Have I willingly doubted any article of the faith?
Have I been religiously indifferent?
Have I given scandal by my behaviour?
Have I been ashamed before others to profess my faith, to pray, to fast...?
Have I failed to defend the holy faith when it was belittled, mocked or falsely interpreted?
Have I exposed myself to influences that are dangerous and erroneous from the standpoint of faith?
Have I actively taken part in heretical, schismatic or ecumenical services?
Have I received the holy sacraments unworthily?
Have I neglected to know thoroughly all the important truths of the holy religion?
Have I sinned by superstition, fortune-telling, card reading, spiritism, magic, astrology, the use of horoscopes, talismans, homeopathy and the like?
Have I been willingly distracted at prayer?
Have I harboured distrust in God's help?
Have I murmured against God in times of affliction?
Have I presumptuously relied on God's mercy?
Have I long put off penance and the amendment of my life?
Have I been ready to offend God by grave sins for human respect, for favour or for temporal gain?
Have I on the whole given more attention in my life to the world than to God, to the body than to the soul, to possessions than to spiritual things?
Have I taken God's name in vain?
Have I taken the names of the saints in vain?
Have I used abusive language and cursed?
Have I blasphemed?
Have I sworn falsely, or without sufficient need?
Have I failed to keep the promises I made?
Have I mocked holy things?
Have I misused God and His Church for earthly ends? (for my own economic or political advantage)
Have I through my own fault missed Holy Mass on a Sunday or a holy day of obligation?
Have I come late to Holy Mass out of negligence?
Have I behaved irreverently or scandalously in church, or worn irreverent clothing?
Have I without serious reason done heavy work, business or shopping on a Sunday or feast day?
Have I been disrespectful to my mother, my father, my teachers or my superiors?
Have I disobeyed my mother, my father, my parents or my superiors in important matters?
Have I failed to pray with my mother, my father and my family and to spend time with them?
Have I punished my children too harshly and unjustly?
Have I tolerated evil things in my children?
Have we as spouses failed to live in love, harmony and Christian decency?
Have I failed to treat consecrated persons (priests, religious, seminarians) with the reverence due to them?
Have I sinned against love for my homeland, my nation, those around me?
Have I harmed my health by intemperance? (e.g. in food, drink, smoking, alcohol, drugs, gambling, otherwise....)
Have I been fussy about food?
Have I entertained the thought of taking my own life or my neighbour's?
Have I harmed myself or my neighbour in body or in health?
Have I wasted time? (e.g. at the computer, watching television...)
Have I nourished brutality in myself?
Have I advised, approved or assisted in an abortion?
Have I deliberately caused my neighbour illness or injury?
Have I endangered myself and others by dangerous driving?
Have I lived in hatred and enmity with my neighbours?
Have I spread national or racial hatred and let it shape my conduct?
Have I been vengeful?
Have I been prone to anger?
Have I been jealous?
Have I been unforgiving?
Have I harmed my neighbour's soul by scandal: by bad example, immodest dress, talk, song or books, or by advising, consenting to, approving or inciting to sin, or by keeping silent about it.
Have I avoided helping my neighbour in his real need?
Have I failed to wish conversion and salvation for every person, excluding others from this love?
Have I taken pleasure in impure thoughts and images?
Have I willingly aroused impure images and feelings? (e.g. by reading immoral books, listening to impure talk, through pornography, the internet, contacts on social networks, etc.)
Have I engaged in obscene talk?
Have I asked something immoral of my neighbour?
Have I sinned by impure looks?
Have I given scandal by immodest dress?
Have I given scandal by immodest exposure of my body, or by impure acts in front of others?
Have I circulated records of my own immoral acts, or those of others, on social networks?
Have I committed impure acts upon myself? (sinful touches, completed self-abuse)
Have I committed impure acts with other persons?
Have I increased my guilt in fornication by the use of contraception?
Have I deliberately sought occasions of sin against purity in unsuitable company? (e.g. at dances, in bars, in night-time wanderings and elsewhere)
Have I sought out and kept up sinful and illicit relationships?
Have I had illicit desire for another's property?
Have I taken another's property secretly, by theft or by robbery? (From whom, what and where?)
Have I taken things belonging to the Lord's temple and so committed sacrilege?
Have I helped or advised another in a theft?
Have I failed to prevent a theft although I could have?
Have I cheated anyone in a sale or purchase? (whether by counterfeit money, false particulars or weight, poor-quality goods or dishonest work, etc.)
Have I deliberately damaged my neighbour's property? (whether on buildings, fields, meadows, forests, gardens, by usury, by withholding wages, by dishonest bankruptcy)
Have I failed to fulfil the duties agreed with my employer?
Have I failed to pay my rent properly and a just tax?
Have I travelled without a valid ticket, fare-dodging?
Have I squandered my property thoughtlessly?
Have I dealt carelessly with God's earthly gifts, with animals, with nature, with food?
Have I failed to contribute to the needs of the Church?
Have I lied by exaggeration?
Have I lied to my neighbour's harm?
Have I sinned by pretence and hypocrisy?
Have I condemned my neighbour unjustly?
Have I spoken needlessly of my neighbour's faults? (detraction)
Have I spread invented faults about my neighbour? (calumny)
Have I gladly listened to detraction or calumny?
Have I belittled, reviled and dishonoured my neighbour?
In justified and necessary criticism, have I failed to keep respect for the office of those in authority?
Have I set my neighbours against one another and so destroyed their friendship?
Have I failed to defend my neighbour's good name?
Have I failed to retract and refute a slander?
Have I given false testimony before the authorities, orally or in writing, to my neighbour's harm?
Have I betrayed a secret entrusted to me?
Have I knowingly listened to another's confession?
Have I falsified documents? (deeds, letters, certificates, seals, etc.)
Have I wrongfully read another's private and confidential letters and papers?
Have I eaten meat on Fridays without another penance in its place?
Have I offered meat dishes to others at a time of abstinence?
Have I failed to keep the prescribed fast on Ash Wednesday or Good Friday?
Have I failed to go to confession at least once a year?
Have I failed to receive the Body of Christ during the Easter season?
Have I committed sacrilege by receiving a holy sacrament unworthily?
Have I taken part in a dance or a boisterous wedding feast at a forbidden time?
Have I incited another to sin?
Have I commanded another to act sinfully?
Have I approved another's sin?
Have I praised the sins of others?
Have I kept silent about another's sin?
Have I failed to punish another for his sins although it was my duty?
Have I taken part in another's sin?
Have I defended sinful conduct?
Have I been proud / self-satisfied? (about what?)
Have I given myself over to excessive luxury in dress?
Have I been wasteful?
Have I been miserly and hard-hearted about necessary things?
Have I been envious, or glad at another's misfortune?
Have I given myself to immoderate drinking or to gambling, to the hurt and ruin of my family and household?
Have I given way to anger and rage, to abuse and insults?
Have I given myself to spiritual and bodily sloth?
